verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers markdown conversion (`return_page_markdown`) and semantic field extraction via `ai_query`/`ai_extract_rules`/`extract_rules`, which can produce cleaner, more structured output than raw HTML, but there is no documented feature for chunking content into discrete semantic segments sized for retrieval pipelines. missing for 10: explicit chunking/segmentation feature, chunk-size or chunk-boundary controls, retrieval-pipeline-specific output format, independent evidence of use in RAG workflows.
